# Wan-Ting Lee (李宛庭) | Full-Stack Developer

> Portfolio of Wan-Ting Lee, a Full-Stack Developer based in Taoyuan, Taiwan, with a semiconductor industry background (Taiwan Mobile, TSMC, VIS). Available in Traditional Chinese (default URLs) and English (prefix any path with `/en`, e.g. https://tingwtlee.dev/en/about).

## Pages

- [Home](https://tingwtlee.dev/): Introduction and headline.
- [About](https://tingwtlee.dev/about): Background spanning advanced semiconductor process integration and full-stack software development.
- [Skills](https://tingwtlee.dev/skills): Technology stack grouped by area.
- [Experience](https://tingwtlee.dev/experience): Work history at Taiwan Mobile, TSMC and VIS, with project highlights.
- [Projects](https://tingwtlee.dev/projects): Project showcase.
- [Scheduled Monitoring & Alerting System](https://tingwtlee.dev/projects/monitoring): Case study of a rule-based system that monitors a database and logs and sends email/SMS alerts, with a suppression window to avoid repeat notifications and a distributed lock to avoid duplicate runs.
- [The Journey from Java 8 to 17](https://tingwtlee.dev/projects/upgrade-jdk17): Case study of upgrading a billing platform from JDK 8 + Spring Boot 2 to JDK 17 + Spring Boot 3 to fix Checkmarx and WhiteSource findings, using AI-assisted unit tests and API automation tests as a safety net.
- [API Latency Dashboards](https://tingwtlee.dev/projects/latency-dashboard): Case study of OpenSearch Dashboards built on Filebeat logs sharing one trace ID, used to find slow APIs, the most-called APIs, repeated external API calls and N+1 DB queries.
- [Social Posts to Notion via LINE](https://tingwtlee.dev/projects/social-notion): Personal project that uses Google Apps Script and a LINE bot to save social media posts from multiple platforms into one searchable Notion database.
- [Pizza Factory Simulator](https://tingwtlee.dev/projects/pizza-factory-simulator): Personal project: Industrial Engineering and production planning on a seven-station pizza line, with due-date estimation, lot handling, recipe adjustment and live KPIs, built on RabbitMQ commands, Kafka events and a 3D dashboard.
- [Education](https://tingwtlee.dev/education): Linköping University (M.S.) and National Tsing Hua University (B.S.).
